h1: What is a Bible verse for sleep prayer?
title_lead: Finding a Bible verse for sleep prayer
meta_description: Discover a quiet nightly practice using scripture. Read or listen to Psalms for sleep with our app, featuring KJV and Reina-Valera 1909 readings.
direct_answer: A Bible verse for sleep prayer is a passage of scripture used to center your heart on God before rest. Many find peace in reading or listening to the Psalms. This nightly practice helps quiet the mind by focusing on the word of God rather than the worries of the day.

sections.heading: Which verses help with rest?
paragraphs: Many people turn to the Psalms when they seek quiet at the end of the day. The words of David offer a way to speak to God when the house is still. You might read Psalm 4:8, which says: 'I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, Lord, only makest me dwell in safety.' This verse reminds us that our safety rests in the hands of the Creator. It is a simple, honest prayer for a tired soul.

Another passage often used for sleep is Psalm 121:4: 'Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.' Knowing that God is always watching provides a sense of comfort. You do not need to carry the weight of the world through the night. You can set your burdens down. Reading these words slowly allows them to sink deep into your spirit. It is not about rushing through a list of verses. It is about dwelling in the truth of the text until your heart feels settled.
bullets: Psalm 4:8: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep.
Psalm 121:4: He that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
Psalm 3:5: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the Lord sustained me.
Psalm 91:1: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

sections.heading: How to build a nightly practice
paragraphs: A nightly practice is a rhythm of turning your thoughts toward scripture. You might start by reading a short passage. Then, you can sit in the silence for a few moments. Our app provides whispered readings of the Psalms to help you focus. These recordings are designed to be heard in the quiet of your bedroom. You can use the sleep timer to let the reading fade away as you drift toward rest.

Consistency matters more than the length of your reading. Even five minutes of focused time can change the tone of your evening. You may choose to read the same verse for a week. Let the words become familiar. When you hear them whispered, you can let your guard down. You are not performing a task. You are simply being present with the word of God. This is the foundation of our approach to evening rest.

sections.heading: Scripture in Spanish and English
paragraphs: We believe that the word of God should be accessible to every family. For those who prefer to read or hear the Bible in Spanish, we offer the Reina-Valera 1909. You can find comfort in Salmo 4:8: 'En paz me acostaré, y asimismo dormiré; Porque tú solo, Jehová, me harás estar confiado.' The beauty of these ancient words remains the same in every language. Whether you read in English or Spanish, the goal is the same.

Our app includes a space called Mi Refugio. This is where you can find Bible chat and readings in Spanish. It is a dedicated area for your family to engage with the text. We want you to feel at home as you seek the Lord. You can explore our other resources, such as Bible verses for sleep and anxiety: what to read when worry keeps you up or Bible verses for sleep: 10 to read before bed. Each page is meant to guide you toward a quiet heart.

sections.heading: Bible stories told in a Black church voice
paragraphs: Representation in scripture is a vital part of our connection to the stories of the Bible. We feature Hush Harbor, a collection of Bible stories told in a Black church voice. These stories bring the history of the faith to life in a way that honors the heritage of many of our readers. You can learn more about this in our guide, Black people in the Bible: who they are, with chapter and verse.

These stories are not just for children. They are for anyone who wants to see themselves in the narrative of God. By centering these accounts, we hope to provide a deeper sense of belonging. You are part of a long line of believers. Their struggles and their triumphs are yours as well. As you prepare for sleep, remember that you are part of a story that spans generations. Let these accounts fill your mind as you close your eyes for the night.

faq.q: What is the best Bible verse to read before going to sleep?
faq.a: There is no single best verse, as every person finds comfort in different passages. Many readers prefer Psalm 4:8 for its direct mention of lying down in peace. You should choose a verse that speaks to your current need and read it slowly until you feel a sense of calm in your heart.

faq.q: Can I listen to whispered Psalms in Spanish?
faq.a: Yes, you can listen to whispered Psalms in Spanish through our app. We provide the Reina-Valera 1909 translation for our Spanish-speaking community. These readings are designed to be a gentle part of your nightly practice, helping you focus on the word of God as you prepare for your time of rest.

faq.q: How does the sleep timer work on the app?
faq.a: The sleep timer allows you to set a specific duration for your whispered Bible readings. Once the time is reached, the audio will gently fade out. This feature helps you listen to scripture without needing to interact with your device again, allowing you to remain in a state of quiet and focus.

faq.q: Is there a way to use the app without a subscription?
faq.a: We offer a free lane that you can use forever. This includes access to a variety of features to support your daily Bible practice. If you choose to support our work further, you can move to the paid lane. We provide these options to ensure that everyone has access to the word of God.
